title: Code of Hammurabi
summary: The Babylonian king issues a monumental law collection now famous from a diorite stele.
body: The prologue, casuistic rulings, and carved relief present justice as a royal duty. The text is a window on Old Babylonian society, not a modern statute book. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Roth, Law Collections from Mesopotamia and Asia Minor
